title: Studio

canonical.text:
This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are
splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing
of value is hanging here. At the south end of the room is an open door
(also covered with paint). A dark and narrow chimney leads up from a
fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely
you could get back down.

prompt:
Create one complete static illustration of Studio.

Viewpoint: View across the studio toward the southern open door and fireplace.

The scene establishes these features: This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here. At the south end of the room is an open door (also covered with paint). A dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.

Composition: Show broad paint-spattered surfaces, empty wall areas and the narrow upward chimney. Suggest many colors in grouped patches rather than enforcing an exact 69-color count.

Appearance of this illustration: Depict the complete room presentation described above.

Canonical room dressing: Loosely attached to a wall is a small piece of paper. Preserve this coarse room presentation unless the state description above specifies a different appearance.

Lighting and color: Restrained warm/cool paint patches over neutral room values.

Shared world design: Broad cool gray and brown stone planes and soft non-diegetic illustrative fill. Do not add common fixtures to unrelated rooms.

Style: Painterly adventure-game illustration recalling fine late-1980s and early-1990s computer artwork; natural proportions, restrained brushwork, readable silhouettes and broad tonal masses. Aim for roughly 256 visually significant colors, broad related color regions, controlled shading and clear dark/light separation. No exact RGB-count requirement, photographic color noise, excessive gradients or microtextures.

Keep this room camera, underlying architecture, terrain layout, light direction and palette consistent across its variants. Depict the complete scene, including the appearance stated above.

Landscape source composition near 4:3. Final scene is 256 by 159 pixels. Allow safe center cropping to 256:159, keeping essential subjects inside the central 82.8 percent of source height and away from the side boundaries. Use clear silhouettes and broad readable shapes at that final size.

Exclude game UI, borders, captions, labels, readable lettering, photographic detail, pixel grids and enlarged pixels. Do not add characters, significant props, openings or events beyond the established scene. Do not depict an action in progress or a before/after collage.
negative_prompt: No UI, borders, readable text, photorealism, pixel grid, invented props, extra exits or transient action events.
